TITLE: Fast-Transient Snap
DESCRIPTION: Internal renderer-test archetype (not shipped to the library). Hard geometric kaleidoscopic snap that jumps onto discrete facet/rotation steps on sharp audio onsets. Binds chroma_AudioPeak and the lowest FFT band (chroma_AudioFFT[0]) for transient strength and FRAMECOUNT for a per-frame strobe. Covers the FAST-TRANSIENT edge case: snappy, quantised response to sharp peaks while remaining a sane, non-black, non-NaN image at zero audio (RMS=peak=0, FFT all 0, BPM=120).
